mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, thereby producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5% for two consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE is below 5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in real GDP growth below 1% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate sales and earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth is below 1% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index for four consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of four consecutive monthly INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous and persistent rise in both the federal funds rate and consumer price index above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual monetary tightening and inflationary pressure, which erodes real corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 12-month MA and CPIAUCSL > 12-month MA for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month moving averages for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the Housing Starts index below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which negatively impacts construction and related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-month MA for six consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during six consecutive months of HOUST below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both payroll employment and unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals a compositional shift in the labor market (e.g., increased part-time underemployment), which reduces effective labor productivity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE rises in the same month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both PAYEMS and UNRATE rise in the same month for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real personal income (proxied by RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening household purchasing power, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month MA for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of RSAFS below its 12-month moving average.
